ModMetaData.name: Modular Turrets
ModMetaData.author: Hakurua
ModMetaData.description: Modular turrets and upgradeable modular batteries for RimWorld 1.7/Waylith. Craft a base, choose one of eleven main heads, then install and upgrade interchangeable modules through assembly management. Batteries offer expandable storage and optional efficiency, generation, wireless-supply, protection and reserve modules. Standard Harmony is required and is not bundled. Optional compatibility assemblies load only with their matching mods; the core works independently. Created by Hakurua. Project-authored material is released under MIT. Unofficial community content, not endorsed by Ludeon Studios. See NOTICE.txt for the publisher acknowledgement.
